name: Sidhe Lord (CR 23)
body:
SIDHE LORD
CR 23

XP 819,200
N Medium fey
Init +8; Senses low-light vision; true seeing; Perception +41

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 19, flat-footed 21 (+7 glammered padded armor, +8 Dex, +4 shield, +1 dodge)
hp 434 (30d6 + 267)
Fort +9, Ref +21, Will +21
DR 15/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 35 ft.
Melee +5 legendary vorpal, brilliant energy short sword +28/+23/+18 (1d6 +10)
Special Attacks eldritch blast 15d6
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th)

Constant–detect magic, shield, true seeing
At will–charm monster, hypnotism, deep slumber (DC 33)
3/day-mass suggestion, power word blind, mass charm monster, antipathy, sympathy (DC 33)
1/day–dominate monster, irresistible dance (DC 33)

Spells Prepared (CL 20th)

0th–dancing lights, ghost sound, mending, prestidigitation (DC 33)
1th–disguise self (2), true strike, unseen servant (DC 34)
2th–blindness/deafness (2), hideous laughter (2)(DC 35)
3th–tiny hut, blink, keen edge, nondetection (DC 36)
4th–hallucinatory terrain, wall of fire, wall of ice, confusion (DC 37)
5th–dream, mirage arcana, nightmare, fabricate (DC 38)
6th-greater heroism, mislead, shadow walk, veil (DC 39)
7th–control weather, phase door, mass invisibility, project image (DC 40)
8th–maze, mind blank, polar ray, sunburst (DC 41)
9th–prismatic sphere, shades, wail of the banshee, weird (DC 42)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 27, Con 25, Int 31, Wis 27, Cha 46
Base Atk +15; CMB +23; CMD 27
Feats Weapon Finesse, Dodge, Mobility, Spring Attack, Combat Reflexes, Agile Maneuvers, Toughness, Acrobatic Steps, Critical Focus, Lightning Reflexes, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Iron Will, Legendary Combat Reflexes, Quickened Spell-like Ability (irresistible dance), Quickened Spell-like Ability (dominate monster)
Skills Acrobatics +37, Appraise +18, Bluff +51, Climb +33, Craft +39, Diplomacy +51, Disguise +51, Escape Artist +35, Fly +23, Heal +18, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (geography) +20, Knowledge (local)+ 25, Knowledge (nature) +43, Knowledge (planes) +31, Perception+41, Perform +51, Sense Motive +41, Sleight of Hand+33, Stealth +41, Swim +19, Use Magic Device +45

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spellcasting

Sidhe Lords can cast arcane spells as 20th-level wizards.

Eldritch Blast (Sp)

A sidhe lord’s pacts with sources of ancient magic grant him significant, destructive powers. As a standard action, a sidhe lord may make a ranged touch attack against a single creature within 60 feet in order to deal 15d6 damage to that creature.

Sidhe Mage (Su)

A sidhe lord is possessed of ancient and strange magic that is especially difficult to resist. The DCs of all the sidhe lord’s spells is increased by 5 (factored into the profile above.)

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate or cold (unseelie lords only)
Organization solitary, envoy (1 sidhe lord and 5 16th level satyr warriors), or court (1 sidhe lord, 5 16th level satyr warriors, and up to 40 other assorted fey)
Treasure triple plus ring of immortality, glammered padded armor, +5 legendary vorpal brilliant energy shortword

Seelie and Unseelie Lords

Some sidhe lords have ties to the forces of nature, especially the seasons. Such sidhe lords are known as seelie or unseelie lords. Seelie lords are associated with the power of Summer, gain fire resistance 20, and deal an extra 2d6 damage with all melee and ranged attacks. Unseelie lords are associated with the power of Winter, gain cold resistance 20, and deal an extra 2d6 damage with all melee and ranged attacks. Areas in which seelie or unseelie lords dwell for extended periods of time tend to experience weather that reflects the season with which that lord is associated. Understandably, the prolonged presence of certain sidhe lords can be quite problematic for local farmers or those concerned with the balance of nature (such as druids).

Among the deities of law and order, there are those who are disturbed by the thought of change and growth. To these deities, each creature to join the ranks of the gods, each adventurer who slays an elemental force of nature, and each upstart who would bring an end to an old and well-established force of good or evil is a threat to the very reality in which they dwell. There are few creatures old enough to remember those few times when the cosmology of reality itself has been reshaped. Those who are tell of the cataclysms that left only a handful of beings, and fewer gods alive to see how the universe reformed. In answer to their own paranoia, these gods crafted a race of beings out of the elemental forces of stagnation and hunger. Now, these pale, translucent creatures sleep on the ethereal plane waiting, for a new divine spark to ignite and wake them. When they sense that a creature’s divine spark has grown strong enough to begin reaching for godhood, but that it is still weak enough for these lowly creatures to attack, these “spark eaters” rouse themselves from their slumber and begin searching the planes for this new divine spark. Their foe slain and their eternal hunger sated for the moment, they return to the ethereal plane where they allow themselves to fade once more from the notice of lesser beings.
